artifact_types: wedge scoring table (promise-to-payoff) and defensibility rating by data, interface and model layer

invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data

outputs: wedge scoring table (promise-to-payoff) and defensibility rating by data, interface and model layer
responsibility: Assess whether AI creates defensible user value and choose a narrow evidence-backed entry wedge.
